capabilities: Follow the active Markdown note in a sidebar graph
Show backlinks on the left and outgoing links on the right
Show nearby daily notes when the active note is a daily note
Navigate to notes by clicking graph nodes
Configure graph folder, layer limit, and daily context limit
disambiguation: Not a replacement for Obsidian's Graph view; it is a small focus-following sidebar graph, not a whole-vault visualization.
extras: The generated Roam Graph.canvas is a real vault file; manual edits to it are overwritten the next time the graph refreshes.
intentEvidence: Roam Graph uses Obsidian's built-in Canvas as its renderer.
problem: Obsidian's graph views are not a persistent, compact sidebar panel that keeps backlinks, outgoing links and nearby daily notes around the note you are editing.
summary: Focus-following local graph that lives in the right sidebar, rendered as a generated Obsidian Canvas file that tracks the active note.
